description: Finds cocktails that can be made with the ingredients the user has at home (exact matching against a curated recipe database: staples like ice and sugar count as available, garnishes are ignored). Optionally also returns drinks missing only 1–2 ingredients. Ingredient names may be given in English, German, French or Spanish.

ingredients.description: Ingredients the user has, e.g. ["gin", "tonic water", "lime"]

max_missing.description: Also include drinks missing up to this many ingredients

name: find_cocktails
title: Cocktails nach Zutaten finden
